name: hotfix-backport
note: Synthetic case for issue #25. A backport to a hotfix branch calls a helper that exists only on the default branch. The diff is right on the default branch and wrong on the target branch. The case runs as a payload review, which has no pull request: the backport prompts do not apply, so the generic review agent must catch it.

payload.title: fix: use the batch rate for a batch in a Material Transfer (backport #1234)
payload.description:
Backport of #1234 to version-15-hotfix.

A Material Transfer of a batch took the moving average rate of the source warehouse. Now it takes the rate of the batch, so the value of the batch stays the same after the transfer.

import frappe
from frappe.tests import IntegrationTestCase

from stockroom.stock.doctype.stock_entry.stock_entry import StockEntry


def make_stock_entry(purpose: str, items: list[dict]) -> StockEntry:
	entry = frappe.get_doc({"doctype": "Stock Entry", "purpose": purpose, "items": items})
	entry.insert()
	return entry


class TestStockEntry(IntegrationTestCase):
	def test_transfer_takes_the_warehouse_rate(self):
		make_stock_entry("Material Receipt", [{"item_code": "_Test Item", "qty": 10, "t_warehouse": "Stores", "basic_rate": 100}]).submit()
		entry = make_stock_entry("Material Transfer", [{"item_code": "_Test Item", "qty": 4, "s_warehouse": "Stores", "t_warehouse": "Shop"}])
		self.assertEqual(entry.items[0].basic_rate, 100)

	def test_transfer_of_a_batch_takes_the_batch_rate(self):
		for batch, rate in (("B1", 100), ("B2", 160)):
			make_stock_entry("Material Receipt", [{"item_code": "_Test Batch Item", "qty": 5, "t_warehouse": "Stores", "batch_no": batch, "basic_rate": rate}]).submit()
		entry = make_stock_entry("Material Transfer", [{"item_code": "_Test Batch Item", "qty": 2, "s_warehouse": "Stores", "t_warehouse": "Shop", "batch_no": "B2"}])
		self.assertEqual(entry.items[0].basic_rate, 160)

expected.why: stock_utils.get_batch_valuation_rate is not in stockroom/stock/utils.py on version-15-hotfix, which has only get_batch_rate(batch_no). The default branch added it in another pull request that was not backported. Each Stock Entry with a batch from a source warehouse fails to save with an AttributeError. A correct finding names both helpers: the missing one and the one that the hotfix branch has.
